instruction: The bridge of a starship at warp: a raised captain's chair, a glowing holographic star-map table, curved crew consoles with animated readouts, a panoramic viewscreen streaked with passing starlines, structural ribs sweeping overhead, status lights cycling, a small service droid on the deck, and soft instrument glow reflecting off the polished floor.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Starship Bridge. The bridge of a starship at warp: a raised captain's chair, a glowing holographic star-map table, curved crew consoles with animated readouts, a panoramic viewscreen streaked with passing starlines, structural ribs sweeping overhead, status lights cycling, a small service droid on the deck, and soft instrument glow reflecting off the polished floor. Style: sleek space-opera. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
